welcome: Read each feature update and its patches together.

sections.title: Grouped update history
items: The notes window now groups each minor release and its patches on one page, starting with the minor release and appending patches in order under dated version headings. History navigation moves between these grouped pages.

Cleaned up older patch notes to show their own changes without repeating the earlier feature guides, tips, or screenshots. Patch-only updates still do not open the window automatically; use /qt notes anytime.
